sections.heading: Section 1: General Binomial Expansion $(1 + x)^n$ for Rational $n$

questions.q: Find the first three terms in the expansion of $(1 + 4x)^{1/2}$ in ascending powers of $x$.
State the range of values of $x$ for which the binomial expansion of $(1 + 4x)^{1/2}$ is valid.
questions.answer: The expansion of $(1 + u)^n$ for non-integer $n$ requires $|u| < 1$. Here $|4x| < 1 \Rightarrow |x| < 1/4$.

questions.q: Expand $(1 - 2x)^{-1}$ up to the term in $x^3$.

sections.heading: Section 2: Approximating Roots via Binomial Series

questions.q: Use the first three terms of $(1 - x)^{1/2} \approx 1 - \frac{1}{2}x - \frac{1}{8}x^2$ with $x = 0.02$ to approximate $\sqrt{0.98}$.
To approximate $\sqrt{50}$ using the binomial expansion of $(1 + x)^{1/2}$, which factorization is most appropriate?
questions.answer: We factor out the nearest perfect square 49 so that $x = 1/49 \approx 0.0204 \ll 1$, giving rapid convergence: $7(1 + 1/49)^{1/2}$.

questions.q: Find the coefficient of $x^2$ in the expansion of $\dfrac{1 + 2x}{(1 - x)^2}$.

sections.heading: Section 3: Method of Differences & Telescoping Series

questions.q: Use the method of differences to find $\sum_{r=1}^n \dfrac{1}{r(r + 1)}$.
State the general Maclaurin series formula for a function $f(x)$ expanded around $x = 0$.
questions.answer: The standard Maclaurin series expansion is $f(x) = \sum_{n=0}^\infty \frac{f^{(n)}(0)}{n!}x^n$.

questions.q: Find the first three non-zero terms in the Maclaurin series of $\ln(1 + x)$.
questions.answer: Standard series: $\ln(1 + x) = x - \frac{x^2}{2} + \frac{x^3}{3} - \dots$ for $-1 < x \leq 1$.

questions.q: Find the coefficient of $x^3$ in the Maclaurin series of $e^x \sin x$.
